page_title: hop — free menu bar toolkit for macOS

summary.name: hop
summary.one_liner: hop is a free, open source macOS menu bar panel bundling twenty small tools such as a timer, clipboard history, text recognition, window layouts and a lite torrent client.
use_cases: keep a Mac awake during downloads or renders
track time spent on tasks and manage a to-do list
snap windows into halves, thirds or quarters
extract text or QR codes from a screen area
lock the keyboard while cleaning it
annotate screenshots and draw on the live screen during calls
summary.what_it_does: hop puts about twenty small utilities into one menu bar panel, and you switch on the modules you want. Features include a timer with work-rest cycles, a time tracker with to-dos, a keep-awake mode, a system stats monitor, clipboard history that keeps files as well as text, and a file converter and archive tool. It also has window layouts with hotkeys, a screenshot editor, text and QR recognition that runs offline, a color picker, and a VPN switch for VPNs macOS already knows about. The page says all of this works offline apart from update checks and optional helper downloads.
notable: Open source with no accounts, no telemetry and no analytics, per the page
App firewall and VPN switch use macOS system frameworks, as the page describes
Installable through Homebrew cask, and the page mentions 225 GitHub stars
caveats: Torrent engine (~26 MB) and 7-Zip archiver are separate optional downloads that fetch from hop.tools
Some features need macOS permissions such as accessibility or screen recording
